name: stale-update-ignored
description: SIMULATED SETTING, not a measurement: link delays are configured so that A-B and B-C (10 ms one way) are cheaper than A-D and D-C (25 ms one way). B stops at 12 s and the route moves to D (version 2). At 25 s two late, stale ROUTE_UPDATEs reach A from D: version 1 of the current epoch, and version 77 of an older epoch. Both would send readings to the dead B if applied. A ignores them and keeps version 2.
